course.title: Polymer and Composite Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Calculate the longitudinal modulus and tensile strength of a unidirectional composite containing (10) 60 % by volume of sisal fibers in epoxy matrix. The modulus and strength of fiber is 40 GPa and 500 MPa, respectively and the same for matrix is 3.5 GPa and 100 MPa respectively. Find the fraction of load taken by matrix and fiber in the composite.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2020
